title: Vapouriz Premium Millionaires Menthol E-Liquid 10ml
description: For menthol fans with, shall we say, a more refined palate, Millionaires Menthol from Vapouriz is perhaps the ultimate menthol experience. The lightest touch of fresh mint adds a beguiling note of flavour to the bold rush of menthol that rushes up to meet your senses from the first vape, falling away to a deliciously cool and refreshing exhale. Vapouriz E-Liquids are expertly-crafted by Vapouriz Labs UK to deliver intense flavour and stunning vapour production for your e-cigarette setup. Browse the full collection of Vapouriz Premium E-Liquids and pick up the perfect pairing for any Vape Kit , Starter Vape Kits or Compact Pod Vape Kit . We’ve got a selection of formulations to suit all styles of e-cigarette devices, including High-PG blends for classic vaping as well as Vapouriz Nicotine Salts and adaptable 50:50 Vape Juice options.
